title: mediaplane.drift/v1

ok.description: false when drift couldn't look: an error diagnostic says why

clear.description: nothing drifted, and every resource and secret was checked: drift exits 0 then, and 2 when not

resource.description: `<app>.<resource>`, or `<app>` for an app that refuses its key

kind.description: field: a managed field holds another value; missing: deleted in the app; secret: the app's own check refuses one of its secrets; key: an app refuses its own key, or a resource holds that key (`source`); left: Mediaplane made it, the stack no longer wants it, and the app still holds it

applied.description: the value Mediaplane applied, when `stack.yaml` has changed it since

actual.description: what the app holds; null when Mediaplane can't read it (`unreadable`)

unreadable.description: the shape Mediaplane can't read the value in

redacted.description: `actual` or `unreadable` held a secret, shown as `***`

secret.description: the secret, or key, by name: never its value

since.description: when drift found it, for a secret or key not checked again until apply sets it

source.description: key: the app whose key the resource holds, which that app refuses

stays.description: left: why apply leaves it in the app; without it, apply removes it

drift.description: what changed in the apps outside Mediaplane

at.description: when drift last checked it, for a verdict taken from then rather than checked again

checks.description: how each secret was checked: names only

unchecked.description: the resources drift couldn't look at

severity.description: an error stopped the command; a warning did not

code.description: what it is, such as `config.unknown-key`: stable, for scripts to act on; the message is for people and may change

diagnostics.description: every error and warning, in the order found

description: what changed in the apps outside Mediaplane: `mediaplane drift --json`
